Package com.hitorro.language

Class POS

java.lang.Object
com.hitorro.language.POS
public class POS extends Object
Wrapper that represents access to the parts of speech from a sentence. This is a wrapper around the tokens. It should not be held onto between calls from a Pooled PartOfSpeech object. The PartOfSpeech object provides this object as a cursor to the current parsed sentence.
